appToggle.label: Enable bot
appToggle.helpText: Turn the bot on or off for this subreddit

modmailAlert.label: Modmail Alerts
modmailAlert.helpText: Tells DejaRepost if it should alert you in modmail when it detects a possible repost

timeThreshold.label: Repost check window
timeThreshold.helpText: select how far back you want DejaRepost to look

enforcementAction.label: Enforcement action
enforcementAction.helpText: Choose what action DejaRepost takes when a match is found

postTypeToggle.label: Toggle enforcement on post types
postTypeToggle.helpText: Tell DejaRepost if it should enforce anti-repost checks on Image, Video, or Text posts. (on for image and video post types by default)

imageTolerance.label: Image Reposts Matching Tolerance
imageTolerance.helpText:
Pick a value between 51 and 99. 51 → Even vaguely similar images will be flagged. 99 → only identical or near-identical duplicate images will trigger the bot.
 Recommended value: 80

videoTolerance.label: Video Reposts Matching Tolerance
videoTolerance.helpText:
Pick a value between 51 and 99. 51 → Even vaguely similar videos will be flagged. 99 → only identical or near-identical duplicate videos will trigger the bot.
 Recommended value: 80

textTolerance.label: Text Reposts Matching Tolerance
textTolerance.helpText:
Pick a value between 51 and 99. 51 → Even vaguely similar text titles will be flagged. 99 → only identical or near-identical duplicate text titles will trigger the bot.
 Recommended value: 80
